name: a steadier measure for the shots spotter
registered: 2026-10-30, before any of these numbers is computed
why: the rate-matched counts (nested leave-one-match-out, threshold set to as many detections as shots) moved single matches by up to 5 hits for a null change (shots_learn/hybrid/cv_control.json); the spotter's model also draws a random 10% early-stopping split (HistGradientBoosting, early stopping on above 10,000 rows), fixed at seed 0 so far

measure.out-of-fold probabilities: leave-one-match-out over the 10 matches (no inner loop: no threshold is chosen), learn.model() with random_state = seed
measure.detections: per unit, every peak of the smoothed probability (learn_shots.peaks, NMS 1 s, threshold 0) with its smoothed value as score
measure.event AP: all units' detections pooled and sorted by score; a detection is right if a not-yet-matched shot label of its unit lies within 2 s (the nearest); AP = sum over right detections of the precision at their rank / number of labels
measure.also: AP per match; the counts at the pooled rate threshold (as many detections as labels) for reference

variants (features already cached).control: features_v4 on the hybrid control tracks (v3b rows through the hybrid's steps: a null change)

reported: per variant: pooled AP per seed, mean and spread
per variant against v4: AP difference on seed-averaged probabilities, 95% bootstrap over matches (5,000 draws, seed 0, paired)
the null change (control - v4) in AP against the same in counts, as the noise floor

use: if AP's null-change spread is clearly smaller than the counts', AP on seed-averaged probabilities becomes the measure for future spotter comparisons (registered per study); past decisions stand as registered, their re-scoring here is exploratory
